contracts.textSnippet: Signed the wrong one? You can tear a contract up and re-sign — right up until your first QA test is recorded. (Re-signing means a fresh kit: anything you built in Scratch stays with the old contract.)
contracts.contentAnchor: Signed the wrong one? You can tear a contract up and re-sign — right up until your first QA test is recorded. (Re-signing means a fresh kit: anything you built in Scratch stays with the old contract.)
contracts.cardText: OLS GAMES · COMMISSIONS · Every contract carries the same brief · REACT — an if/else that chooses · TRACK — a variable that changes in play · END — a game that can finish · WORKS — passes all four QA tests · Catch It · Apples fall, and one bowl waits below. Miss three and the game is over — if you build it that way. · OPEN · Maze Escape · The walls bounce you back to the start. Three stars glitter in the corners — and one locked door stands between your beetle and freedom. · OPEN · Quiz Master ·
